reason: A DSH web GUI skin plugin that lets users select backgrounds, adjust visual effects, and persist theme settings across sessions.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供可自定义背景、预设皮肤及透明度、暗化和模糊调节的界面皮肤面板。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web GUI skin panel for choosing backgrounds, applying presets, and adjusting translucency, dimming, and blur effects.

capabilities: Modifies the host web interface with a skin settings panel and background layer
Fetches image content from user-provided HTTP(S) URLs
Stores skin settings in browser localStorage and a host settings file under the DSH home directory
